Current operator authorization covers this bounded development review/bootstrap only. These observations do not grant runtime admission.

Treat the root failure as open and do not claim a clean canonical toolchain.

uca_review.omitted_action: The reviewed task identity, current grant, or startup binding could be missing; admission checks and the exact Sa-plan task/review bindings constrain this.
uca_review.unsafe_action: A broader path, tool, model, or production effect could be included; the proposal is one-task development scope and has no source/config writes.
uca_review.wrong_timing_or_order: Stale expiry, host/boot, BEAM, or proposal identity could be used; rechecked bindings and the runtime loader must revalidate them before activation.
uca_review.duration_or_stop: Work could continue beyond scope/lease or execute the guardian binary; task lease, finite test manifest, and explicit preserve/do-not-execute limit constrain this.

limits: Approval is for the exact proposal's finite ACTIVATE development scope only. The final grant must bind this review file digest, proposal path/digest, current session, host/boot, expiry, loaded control IDs, and dependency digest at startup.

Build/test commands operate from canonical dev.root. The 31 candidate checks do not erase the canonical-root failure; stop if activation would invoke the unadmitted guardian binary or if source, scope, identity, or task state changes.
No production admission, global UOS verification, four-client parity, complete 14-command acceptance, concurrent-session acceptance, or runtime behavior is established by this review.
